The '''2024 TPM 25th Anniversary Retro''' was a [[Players Committee]] [[GEMP]] league for the 25th anniversary of ''The Phantom Menace''. It ran from 8:00 pm Eastern on 24 April 2024 (0:00 GEMP time) until 8:00 pm Eastern on 19 May 2024. The announced card pool was [[Premiere - Tatooine]] only. [[Joe Horbey]] finished first.<ref name="tpm25structure">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84427 TPM 25 Events! (Structure, Rules, Accomplishments List, Prizes)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (9 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011700/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84427.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="tpm25end">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425245#p1425245 TPM 25 Open Event - Accomplishments List], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (16 May 2024).</ref><ref name="tpm25standings">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425598#p1425598 FINAL STANDINGS: TPM 25 Events], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (28 May 2024).</ref>

On 12 April 2024 the GEMP league was still [[Premiere - Reflections II]], and it was to be switched to [[Premiere - Tatooine]] before the 24 April start.<ref name="tpm25structure">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84427 TPM 25 Events! (Structure, Rules, Accomplishments List, Prizes)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (9 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011700/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84427.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Registration was 15 GEMP gold. Games were posted to a blind table, with a 45-minute timer for each player, a six-game minimum for participation prizes, and a 12-game ceiling. Standings counted 3 points for a win and 1 point for a loss.<ref name="tpm25structure">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84427 TPM 25 Events! (Structure, Rules, Accomplishments List, Prizes)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (9 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011700/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84427.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Prizes ==

Players with six or more games were posted for a sealed Tatooine booster pack (the top 15 if more than 15 players reached six games, and a random played rare for the others), one random played rare, a GEMP Tatooine booster box, and the GEMP foils [[Darth Maul, Young Apprentice]] AI and [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]] AI. The top 8 each received 100 GEMP gold, a GEMP Coruscant booster box, and a GEMP Theed Palace booster box. GEMP prizes were awarded on 26 May 2024. The sealed packs and played rares were entered on the prize spreadsheet on 28 May 2024.<ref name="tpm25prizes">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1424591#p1424591 PRIZE SUPPORT: The Phantom Menace 25th Anniversary Events], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (30 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011631/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84208.html Internet Archive].</ref>
